customManagers.description: Update deps annotated with a trailing `# renovate: datasource=X depName=Y [packageName=…] [versioning=…] [extractVersion=…] [registryUrl=…]` comment on the same line as the version. Keys must appear in this order; misordered or unknown keys are silently ignored. versioning defaults to the datasource's default. Whitespace is `[ \t]`, not `\s`, so a match can never span lines and pair a version with the next line's annotation. arg0 = file pattern.
